question: The surface area of a sphere is 196 pi cm². The volume of the sphere is:
solution:
Given:

The surface area of a sphere is 196 pi sq. cm.

Concept used:

The volume of a sphere = 4/3πr³

Surface area of a sphere = 4πr2

r = radius of the sphere

Calculation:

According to the question,

4πr² = 196 pi 

⇒ r2 = 49

⇒ r = 7

Now,

Volume of the sphere = (4/3) × (22/7) × 7³

⇒ frac{{1372pi }}{3}

 

∴ The volume of the sphere (in cu m) is frac{{1372pi }}{3}
